bullets.text: A grieving family in Thirumazhisai endured a two-and-a-half-hour wait for cremation due to a sudden power outage, and the office should monitor municipal utility reliability.
Power trouble disrupted crematorium services in Thirumazhisai, causing delays for a family performing last rites, prompting the office to check backup generator readiness across facilities.
Velachery floods persist despite extensive drainage infrastructure covering 32.6 km of roads, requiring the constituency team to investigate why existing systems fail.
Commuters faced severe hardship in Velachery and Adambakkam because electric trains from Velachery bypassed the Adambakkam station, prompting the office to coordinate with railway authorities.
Over 3,000 Avadi streetlights remained non-functional despite a large maintenance contract, and the district team must urge the corporation to fix dark roads amid rains.
Ambattur police arrested a mother and son for sexually harassing two minor girls, and the office should track the legal proceedings closely.
Auto workers in Thiruvallur protested against the Vettri Payanam scheme, demanding reconsideration because it threatens their livelihoods, requiring the district team to monitor union talks.
Vultr plans to deploy a 20 MW supercluster in Chennai to expand data centres, and the portfolio team should support this infrastructure investment.
Tata Communications plans to invest ₹4,000 crore to build an AI-ready fibre network connecting major data centres, which the portfolio team should monitor.
IIT Madras released a white paper stating AI will not eliminate all jobs but will impact entry-level roles in IT and banking, prompting the office to watch workforce trends.
